snippet.title: Tidy Mall Together - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Tidy Mall Together On Steam 
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5451610/Tidy_Mall_Together/

A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 4,600 runaway things back onto the shelves of 11 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.
